title: SlowBuffer has been removed
summary: Node.js removed SlowBuffer (DEP0030: documentation-only since v6.0.0, runtime deprecation since v24.0.0, end-of-life since v25.0.0).

constraints: Keep the behavior of the code unchanged; check the replacement's argument and return-value differences.

steps.title: Replace the usage
steps.instructions: Replace each reported use of SlowBuffer with Buffer.allocUnsafeSlow(size).

verification.purpose: Run the repository tests when defined.
